questions.passage: Water has no hardness; it is completely __________ (yield) to the touch, yet is hard as concrete when impacted at high speed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: yield → yielding: 'be + 현재분사'로 상태를 나타내는 형용사적 분사 형태
det.analysis: yield(동사) → yielding(현재분사). 'is completely yielding to the touch'에서 be동사 뒤 현재분사가 형용사처럼 쓰여 '순응하는' 상태를 나타낸다
det.tip: yielding to the touch=촉감에 순응하는 (현재분사)

questions.passage: Water essentially has no persona of its own, but has an extraordinary quality. Water as a liquid has no shape, yet it is readily defined by its surroundings. Water has no hardness; it is completely yielding to the touch, yet is __________ when impacted at high speed. Water has no color when viewed in a transparent container, yet becomes vividly green or blue as an ocean, and readily reflects at its surface everything around it. Pure water has no taste, yet it readily absorbs and transmits the taste of any suspended or dissolved substances. It has no smell, yet, as atmospheric humidity, readily distributes the aromas of its surroundings. This ubiquitous part of our environment truly has a variable personality, readily changing to assimilate its surroundings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 물은 촉감에 완전히 순응하지만, 고속 충돌 시에는 ______하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① hard as concrete(콘크리트처럼 단단한): 'yielding(순응하는)'과 'yet(그러나)'의 대조가 단단함을 가리킴 ← 정답
❌ ② soft as cloth(천처럼 부드러운): yet 대조와 반대
❌ ③ light as air(공기처럼 가벼운): 단단함 대조와 무관
❌ ④ cold as ice(얼음처럼 차가운): 온도 개념으로 무관
det.tip: completely yielding ↔ hard as concrete 대조가 단서

questions.passage: Water essentially has no persona of its own, but has an extraordinary quality. Water as a liquid has no shape, yet it is readily __________. Water has no hardness; it is completely yielding to the touch, yet is hard as concrete when impacted at high speed. Water has no color when viewed in a transparent container, yet becomes vividly green or blue as an ocean, and readily reflects at its surface everything around it. Pure water has no taste, yet it readily absorbs and transmits the taste of any suspended or dissolved substances. It has no smell, yet, as atmospheric humidity, readily distributes the aromas of its surroundings. This ubiquitous part of our environment truly has a variable personality, readily changing to assimilate its surroundings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 액체로서 물은 정해진 형태가 없지만, 쉽게 ______된다
det.analysis:
❌ ① frozen into solid blocks(단단한 덩어리로 얼려지는): 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ② divided into equal parts(똑같이 나뉘는): 형태 없음과 무관
✅ ③ defined by its surroundings(주변에 의해 규정되는): 형태가 없어 담기는 곳(주변)에 따라 모양이 정해짐 ← 정답
❌ ④ hidden from direct view(직접 시야에서 가려지는): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: no shape → readily defined by its surroundings: 주변이 형태를 결정
